method: Full run: 9 batches, target 50ms. Paired runs: base/A/B/B/A/base, 7 batches target 100ms per case per run; summary is median of two trial medians. Same machine, Qt windows backend, Release shared library; warmed single-thread wall time.

variants.variant_a: Parser split/FH, linear Code128, per-render Font0, opaque GF scanlines
variants.variant_b: A + per-render glyph path cache, QR callback, immutable PDF417/MaxiCode ECC tables, wide GF clipping

baseline.method: Warmed single-thread wall time, median of batch means; allocations and destruction included; file I/O excluded. p95 is NOT request latency.

variant_a.method: Warmed single-thread wall time, median of batch means; allocations and destruction included; file I/O excluded. p95 is NOT request latency.
variant_a.revision: 4bdc94f + variant A: parser, Code128, per-call font, GF

variant_b.method: Warmed single-thread wall time, median of batch means; allocations and destruction included; file I/O excluded. p95 is NOT request latency.
